text:
anna: FYI - SolarFlare Labs opened a dispute for INV-2026-0887. They say an automated import job mis-flagged prod and caused sustained retries during onboarding. Asking for a one-time remedial credit and Net45 for the next invoice while they fix it.
maya: How much are they requesting and do we have logs?
anna: Asking $63,400 credit. Uploaded CSV + infra log excerpts. Current invoice balance $189,200.
ben: From Sales: customer is strategic; renewal in 4 weeks. Recommend one-time credit to avoid churn but require written remediation plan.
sara (RevOps): If we grant $63.4k tag GL 4802_customer_recovery and reason onboarding_retry. Need Finance approval and narrow payment-term exception.
maya: Finance questions: 1) Contra-revenue now or next quarter? 2) Require amendment before Net45?
anna: SolarFlare says they'll sign amendment in 48 hrs if we apply credit immediately and hold collections.
ben: Legal: draft amendment limited to granting Net45 for invoice INV-2026-0888 only; include explicit non-precedent and remediation confirmation. No SLA/pricing edits.
maya: Proposed decision: - Approve one-time customer_recovery credit $63,400 (code CR-ONB-02). - Apply credit to INV-2026-0887 and issue corrected invoice (move original to "adjusted"). - Grant Net45 for INV-2026-0888 conditional on countersigned amendment within 72 hours. - Collections: pause dunning while amendment pending. - Cap: no additional retro credits > $75k in 12 months without VP-Finance signoff.
revops: I'll produce the internal memo and update AR aging when billing posts the corrected invoice. Confirm accounting tag and memo language.
maya: Approved under delegated limits. Approver: Maya (Finance Lead). Conditions: countersigned amendment within 72 hrs; remediation plan received; escalation to VP-Finance for any further requests.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0887 link: https://billing.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-2026-0887 189200 balance. Collections: paused pending adjustment.
anna: I'll coordinate signature and post update when done. Thanks everyone.
